meta.title: OpenRouter provider
meta.description: Seeds the OpenRouter route (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1) into the Models page with nine curated models: deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017, openai/gpt-6.2-sol, openai/gpt-6.2-astra, google/gemini-4-carbon, google/gemini-4-hydrogen, google/gemini-4-neon, anthropic/claude-fable-5.2, anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5 and anthropic/claude-opus-5.5 (all with text and image input; reasoning efforts follow each model's supported levels, default high). The seed is authoritative: it is re-applied on every start, so manual edits to this route in Models are overwritten; uninstall the plugin to customize or remove the route. The API key resolves per request from the OPENROUTER_API_KEY credential (Settings > Credentials or the environment); no key is stored in the plugin.
